apps.localizedDescription:
·.

Features:

• All 16 classic tools — free-form and rectangle select, eraser / color eraser, fill, pick color, magnifier, pencil, brush, airbrush, text, line, curve, rectangle, polygon, ellipse and rounded rectangle, each with its classic options.
• The 28-color palette — left click for foreground, right click (long-press on touch) for background, double-click to define a custom color.
• Type directly on the canvas — drag a text box, then move and resize it by its border and 8 handles, with a floating Fonts toolbar.
• Image menu — Flip/Rotate, Stretch/Skew, Invert Colors, Attributes and Clear Image, on the whole picture or the current selection.
• Pixel-perfect — every primitive is aliased and drawn on whole pixels; zoom to 800% with a grid and thumbnail.

versions.localizedDescription:
The first release of RetroPaint — the classic bitmap editor for Mac, iPad and iPhone.

Mac — RetroPaint-macOS.dmg (macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel). Open the DMG and drag RetroPaint to Applications. This build isn't notarized yet: on first launch, right-click the app and choose Open, or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

iPhone & iPad — RetroPaint-iOS.ipa (iOS 17+). Unsigned; install it with AltStore or Sideloadly, which sign it with your Apple ID.

Highlights: all 16 classic tools, the 28-color palette, type-on-canvas text with a movable/resizable box and Fonts toolbar, Image menu (flip/rotate, stretch/skew, invert, attributes), PNG/BMP/JPEG/GIF/TIFF, clipboard, print and share.
